name: LimitedBox
desc: Can contain one child component, limiting the area where the child component can reside by specifying the maximum width and height.

fields.name: maxWidth
fields.desc: The maximum width limit to apply in the absence of a [BoxConstraints.maxWidth] constraint.

fields.name: maxHeight
fields.desc: The maximum height limit to apply in the absence of a [BoxConstraints.maxHeight] constraint.
